reviews.text: A huge thank you to Marguerite for her guidance, which allowed us to build a genuine relationship of trust with our dog. She worked in a structured and sustainable way, using a kind and positive approach that prioritizes mutual understanding! I highly recommend her for learning to read your dog and creating a peaceful and balanced daily life for you and your dog, tailored to your specific needs.

Marguerite has been working with us on Zoya, a young Miniature American Shepherd, since January 2026. I recommend her without hesitation.

She is attentive, caring, and readily available. For example, we can send her messages between sessions, and she responds quickly.

I feel reassured to be working with Marguerite.

Available and competent, Marguerite will find effective solutions tailored to your dog and your schedule!

I highly recommend her :)
Thank you 🤩

I hired Marguerite to train my dog ​​Dune (a Miniature American Shepherd) and I recommend her 100%! She is kind, clear, passionate, and her approach is perfectly suited to Dune's needs and my questions.

Raising a puppy in Paris, with all the challenges of urban life (noise, crowds, other dogs, etc.), isn't easy, but thanks to Marguerite, Dune has made significant progress in socialization and basic training. The sessions are always helpful, practical, and enjoyable, and I see the improvements every day thanks to targeted and achievable practices between sessions.

Thank you, Marguerite, for your excellent support!

I am the owner of Ener, a 10-month-old German Shepherd. Marguerite took the time to understand my concerns and immediately reassured me and put me at ease. Although the first meeting with Ener was a bit hectic, she was very patient, gentle, and effective. Her advice is very helpful, and she remains very attentive to the dog's progress. She is always available if needed. My dog ​​is thrilled. I highly recommend her!
